frozen: 2026-11-01, before any salmon-index computation or model run. Known: the adopted configuration D (k_terr 0.5, a_marine 3000, a_fresh 100) and its errors by culture area (output/forager_binford_20261031/binford_aquatic.json: Northwest Coast median log10 bias -0.58, California and the Great Basin -0.49; Arctic +0.24, Subarctic +0.36, western North America +0.09) and addendum 2's result (a larger marine scale is asked for by those coasts and does not transfer).
why: North America's richest foragers lived on salmon runs: rivers reaching cold northern seas carry anadromous fish far inland every year (the Columbia, the Fraser, the Klamath, the Sacramento, the Yukon). The model's freshwater index treats every river alike and its marine term fades 25 km from the coast.
index: S_salmon at a group: Natural Earth 1:10m river and lake-centre line length within 25 km (km per 100 km2, as W_fresh) counting only river systems that reach the ocean where the WOA18 annual-mean sea surface is below 15 C, in the Northern Hemisphere (the native range of anadromous salmonids; none south of the equator). River systems: polylines joined where an end lies within 3 km of another line; a system reaches the ocean if any of its points lies within 10 km of a WorldClim 5' water cell of the connected world ocean.
model: configuration D (600-year mean as the aquatic addendum) with the aquatic supply a_marine * marine + a_fresh * W_fresh + a_salmon * S_salmon (kg dry matter per km2 of land per year, evenly over the year); k_terr 0.5, a_marine 3000, a_fresh 100 unchanged
fit: a_salmon in {0, 100, 300, 1000, 3000, 10000} on the Arctic, Subarctic and western North American groups (wc.area ARC, NNA, WNA), minimising their median absolute log10 density error
test_blind: the Northwest Coast (BC NWC) and California (SW groups west of 119.5 W and between 32 and 42.5 N), never used for fitting; and the rest of the world (the 66 test groups) as before
adopt_if: a_salmon > 0 is fitted, the Northwest Coast + California median absolute log10 error improves by at least 0.05, and the rest of the world's median absolute log10 error and density rank are not worse by more than 0.01. Then data/foraging_model.json takes a_salmon (with the map's equivalent: the drawn rivers that reach a sea colder than 15 C annual, scaled to Natural Earth detail) and the atlases' foraging is rebuilt.
